title: Spine-named resolution helper egress_port_of(packet) does not exist; the resolution ships decomposed instead
detail: The ratified spine's Consistency Conventions row names egress_port_of(packet) as the (bundle, direction) resolution; the code ships port_dir_of_packet + egress_router_of_port + existing bundle_of_pipe. Functionally equivalent, but the link-vocab render heists were pointed at the spine vocabulary.
recommended_fix: Either add a thin egress_port_of(packet) -> (bundle, dir) wrapper for the heists, or amend the spine's naming row to record the shipped decomposition.
